A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 143 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. Each impostor pays 12 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
